title: Apple cinnamon yogurt cake
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single original food illustration for a recipe card. Subject: Apple cinnamon yogurt cake. Ingredient reference: Apple, Greek yogurt, Flour, Eggs, Sugar, Vegetable oil, Ground cinnamon, Baking powder. Preparation reference: One batch makes 8 portions. Preparation: 20 minutes; cooking: 40 minutes; additional resting/chilling: 30 minutes. Heat the oven to 175 C conventional and line a 20 cm round cake tin with baking paper. Wash, core and dice the apples into 1 cm pieces. Whisk the eggs, sugar, Greek yogurt and vegetable oil in a bowl. Fold in the flour, baking powder and ground cinnamon, then fold in the apple pieces. Spread in the tin and bake for 35 to 40 minutes until golden and a skewer inserted into the centre has no wet batter. Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack and cut into eight slices once cool..
